Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Record Class HubStatus.WaitingJob

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.HubStatus.WaitingJob
Record Components:
jobId - its id
job - its payload as text (toString)
queuedAt - epoch ms it last joined the waiting jobs
attempts - its attempts so far
lastModel - the model of its last failed or handed-back attempt; null if none
lastFailure - why that attempt failed; null if none
eligible - the models that may take it now; empty while every one it may run on is held back or out of limits
Enclosing class:
HubStatus
public static record HubStatus.WaitingJob(long jobId, String job, long queuedAt, int attempts, String lastModel, String lastFailure, List<String> eligible) extends Record
A job waiting for a model: before its first attempt, or between attempts.
